localChanges: The window listing the units on a square now shows each unit's name and state, such as "Musketman (Fortified, Veteran)", with its home city underneath (closes #694).

The active unit's panel is now a card: its moves as pips, its attack, defence and visibility, its home city (click it to open the city), the square it's on, and the other units there (click them to choose one) (closes #699).

A new Cities section lists your cities by what they are building and how many turns are left, the soonest first, and flags any with nothing to build, in civil disorder or starving; click a city to open it (closes #700).

A new Scores section ranks your civilization against the others by Civilization Score, with civilizations you haven't met yet left unnamed; in a game of more than six, it shows the five around you, with a link to the rest (closes #701).
The sidebar's scrollbar is now slimmer and can be dragged.
